title: Tosha_Footsteps Plugin for RPG Maker MZ

posts.author: ToshaAngel
posts.body:
​
Enhance your RPG Maker MZ projects with customizable footstep sounds synchronized with character animations for players and events!
​
​
Spoiler:
Plugin Features
Customizable footstep sounds:
Assign unique sounds to various terrain tags or regions.
Playback modes:
Choose between sequential or random sound playback for each terrain type.
Detailed sound settings:
Adjust volume, pitch, and pan for a fully immersive audio experience.
Event compatibility:
Enable or disable footstep sounds for events, with a <NoFootsteps> tag to exclude specific events.
Animation synchronization:
Sounds play in sync with character animation frames for seamless audio integration.
Spoiler:
How to Use
How to Use:
​
Set up terrain tags or regions:
In the tileset, assign terrain tags or region IDs to map tiles.
Configure plugin parameters:
Add sound settings for each area type (terrain or region), specify tags/IDs, and select the playback mode.
Customize event settings:
Enable or disable footstep sounds for events; add <NoFootsteps> in the event's note to disable sound for specific events.
Adjust animation frames:
Define which animation frames trigger sounds (default frames 0 and 2).
